desc:
Huge boom sound. Could be good for huge explosions or for indoor explosions.

Sound of a firecracker exploding in my garage. Sound is layered and lengthened at different speeds to sound lower pitched overall and longer blast. This is a more layered and lower pitched version of Large explosion.

Recorded with Tascam dr100mkiii internal unidirectional microphone and edited in audacity.
title: Huge big explosion
author: SamsterBirdies
